tips.title: Seal an Interior Room for Sheltering in Place
tips.quality_notes: AI-extracted candidate. Not human-reviewed or approved for operational use.
tips.summary: Create a temporary barrier against contaminated air by sealing windows, doors, and vents in an interior room using plastic sheeting and duct tape, following pre‑planning steps to ensure a secure enclosure.
steps: Lock all doors and close windows, air vents, and fireplace dampers.
Turn off fans, air conditioning, and forced air heating systems.
Move to an interior room with few windows if possible.
Measure and cut thick plastic sheeting several inches wider than each opening.
Label each sheet for easy identification.
Apply duct tape to corners first, then tape down all edges.
Seal any remaining gaps with additional tape or available materials.
prerequisites: plastic sheeting and duct tape stored in your emergency supply kit
tips.expected_result: A sealed room that reduces exposure to contaminated air outside.
failure_modes: unsealed gaps allow contaminated air to enter
tips.evidence_excerpt: Seal all windows, doors and air vents with thick plastic sheeting and duct tape.
